text:
Some air is trapped inside a metal container with a tightly fitting lid.
tightly fitting lid
metal container
air
heat
The container is heated strongly behind a safety screen. The lid is blown off by the increased
pressure of the air inside the container.
What causes the increase in pressure of the air inside the container?
A
Each air particle expands and takes up more room.
B
The air particles move more quickly.
C
The number of particles inside the container increases.
D
The volume occupied by the air decreases.

options.label: A
options.text: Each air particle expands and takes up more room.

options.label: B
options.text: The air particles move more quickly.

options.label: C
options.text: The number of particles inside the container increases.

options.label: D
options.text: The volume occupied by the air decreases.
